correctness.rationale: For the explicitly labeled 12-vertex 5-regular icosahedron, a <=5 initial set cannot force: any possible first force from a five-set makes a six-vertex closed neighbourhood with no further force. Independently enumerated all 4096 masks with a separate synchronous forcing implementation, obtaining 200 minimal six-sets, exactly those with 8 or 9 induced edges; polynomial (200,480,450,220,66,12,1) in degrees 6..12. Constructed the 200-vertex token-exchange graph by one-out/one-in operations, verified 1320 edges and all 200 BFS eccentricities 6 with exact pair distances (1320,5160,6300,5010,2010,100). Finite exhaustive proof applies to this graph alone. Source verify.py also gives 18 complete orbits under 120 automorphisms.
residual_risks: Computational verification extends exactly to its stated finite range, not beyond the analytic proof.
